THIS MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, DR.H.B.PRABHAKARA SASTRY J.,
DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Called again in the afternoon.
2.
The learned counsel for the appellants has again remained absent.

3. A perusal of the order sheet would go to show that inspite of granting several and sufficient opportunities NC: 2024:KHC:2237-DB of not less than five times, the learned counsel for the appellants has not complied the office objections.

4. On 08.01.2024, this Court had made the following observation:

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: "Learned counsel for the appellants prays for time to comply with office objections.

Considering the fact that opportunities of not less than four times have already been granted, the Court suggested that granting of any further time would be only upon payment of cost of Rs.200/- per day, learned counsel prefers seven days time.

Accordingly, imposing a cost of `1000/- payable by the appellants to the Legal Services Committee of this Court within three days from today and filing a compliance memo along with original receipt in the registry to that effect within the said time, as a final last opportunity, seven days time is granted to comply with office objections. .

In case, if, the office objections are not complied after payment of the cost, within the time, list the matter on 17.01.2024."
NC: 2024:KHC:2237-DB 5.
Inspite of above, according to the Registry, learned counsel for the appellants has not filed any memo along with receipt showing the payment of the cost as ordered above.
Further, the office objections have remained not complied.
6. Under the above circumstances, it has to be inferred that the appellants are not interested in prosecuting the appeal which is of the year 2023 and in complying with the office objections.
As such, the appeal stands dismissed for non-compliance of office objections as well as for non-prosecution.
